answer: Persistent work ledger. Each identity must accumulate a private history of solved tasks before its votes or bids count, and the ledger is keyed to a raven-marked hardware token bound to one agent instance. Cloning forces the attacker to rerun the full task history per clone, paying the compute cost times N. A nebula score tracks cross-instance consistency; divergent behavior from one token resets its jade credit balance to zero, so each fake identity restarts at real cost.
